entreParaVer: Sign in to see this page.
semPermissao: This area is only for people who moderate Alumia.

menores.ajuda: Abuse, exploitation or exposure of minors.

ameaca.ajuda: Someone threatens another person's life or safety.

exposicao.ajuda: Address, phone number, ID, intimate photo or other data that exposes someone.

violencia.ajuda: Calls for or encourages violence against people or groups.

autolesao.ajuda: Someone talks about hurting themselves or ending their life. If it is urgent, call 188 (CVV, Brazil).

odio.ajuda: Attack on a person or group because of race, origin, gender, orientation, religion or disability.

assedio.ajuda: Insistence, humiliation or persecution against someone.

golpe.ajuda: An attempt to trick people into giving money or data.

spam.ajuda: Repeated message, sales or promotion out of place.

outro.ajuda: Something that breaks Alumia's rules and is not listed above.

ilegal.ajuda: A crime or content banned by law. Answered within 24 hours.

denunciar.texto: Want to tell us more? (optional, up to 2,000 characters)
denunciar.sigilo: Whoever reports is never revealed: not to the author, not to the moderators.
denunciar.ja: You already reported this. Protocol {protocolo}. We are reviewing it.
denunciar.retido: As a precaution, the post was held until the moderators read the report.
denunciar.acompanhe: You can follow the progress in Notices and in Reports and appeals.
denunciar.visitante: No account? Use the site's Report page: public content also enters the queue.

cifrado.grupoPequeno: In a small group, the author may work out that the report came from someone in the group: only members can open the post.
cifrado.abrindo: Opening the post on this device…
cifrado.naoAbre: This post doesn't open on this device. Moderation doesn't have the group key: the report goes without the content, only with the category and what you write.
cifrado.mandar: Send an excerpt in plain text to moderation
cifrado.custo: Heads up: moderation will read this excerpt; the rest stays encrypted. The excerpt leaves the encryption and is stored with the report.
cifrado.semTrecho: Without the excerpt, the report goes without the content: moderation doesn't have the group key and sees only the category and what you write.
cifrado.rotulo: The excerpt (cut what isn't needed, up to 1,000 characters)
cifrado.foraDoPost: The excerpt must be in the post, with the same words. Cut, but don't rewrite.

silenciar.soAparelho: Only on this device (does not sync to the account)

rotulo.texto: This post is about something that was already checked: {veredito}.
rotulo.ajuda: The post is not deleted: it gets a label with a link to the fact-check.

moderar.sobreOAviso: The person is notified with the rule, the reason and how to appeal (30 days).
moderar.modoLentoAjuda: Minimum interval between two posts by the same person.
moderar.lentoAviso: Slow mode is on here: one post every {tempo}.
moderar.confirmeDestrutivo: Confirm? The person will see this and it stays in the record.

fila.nucleo: Study-circle post: the content only opens with the access recorded and the circle's mediators notified.
fila.procedentes: Upheld decisions in the last 90 days: {n}
fila.historico: What has already been done on this target
fila.descartarNota: Why is there no violation? (kept in the record)
fila.aberto: Excerpt the reporter opened on their device and sent in plain text. It was written by that person: Alumia can't check it against the post, which stays encrypted.
fila.cifradoSem: Encrypted post: moderation doesn't have the group key and the report came without the content.

recursos.ajuda: An appeal is never decided by whoever made the original decision. Decide with the reason written down.
recursos.motivo: Reason for your decision (the person reads it)
recursos.minha: This decision was yours: another moderator has to review it.
recursos.feito: Appeal decided. The person was notified.

lugares.listaAjudaComunidade: Person: cannot write in this community. Staff are never added to the list.
lugares.palavrasNoFiltro: This community’s words and slow mode are in the Communities tab, under Automatic filter.
lugares.listaAjuda: Word: the post is held for the mediators to read. Person: cannot write in this place. Staff are never added to the list.

decisoes.semDenuncias: You have not reported anything yet.
decisoes.semDecisoes: No moderation decisions about what you wrote.

andamento.descartada: Reviewed: no violation of the rules

decisoes.prazoPassou: The 30-day deadline to appeal has passed.
decisoes.recursoTexto: Why should the decision change? (10 to 2,000 characters)

recurso.aberto: Appeal sent: another moderator will review it.
recurso.mantido: Appeal reviewed: the decision was kept.
recurso.revertido: Appeal accepted: the decision was reversed.

decisoes.feito: Appeal sent. You will be told the decision.

silenciados.ajuda: Muting notifies nobody. On the account it works on every device; on this device only, it stays in this browser.
silenciados.dicaPalavra: Write the word (2 characters or more) to mute it.
silenciados.limpar: This list is erased if you use Quick exit.

cuidado.lead: Alumia has written rules, with deadlines and appeals. Here is how it works, no fine print.
cuidado.denunciaTexto: Anyone can report a post, a profile or a community. Whoever reports is never revealed. Each report gets a protocol and you follow it in Notices.
cuidado.filaTexto: Child abuse, threats, exposure of data, incitement to violence and self-harm go to the front of the queue.
cuidado.decisaoTitulo: Every decision has a rule and a reason
cuidado.decisaoTexto: Moderators cite the rule and write the reason. Everything goes into a record that only accepts new lines: nobody deletes or changes what was done.
cuidado.recursoTexto: Whoever was moderated can appeal. The appeal is reviewed by another moderator, never by whoever decided before.
cuidado.lentoTexto: Each place's moderators can ask for an interval between posts or lock a conversation that went off track.
cuidado.silencioTexto: You mute people, conversations, communities and words without notifying anyone. No block is shown to the person muted.
cuidado.desinfoTexto: When a post is about something Fact-checking already verified, it gets a label with the link. The post stays.
cuidado.leiTexto: The Supreme Court decision on article 19 of Brazil's Marco Civil da Internet (Themes 987 and 533) calls for notice, procedure and a reporting channel. This page and the reports page are that channel. Serious illegal content is removed quickly; crimes against honor follow the courts, and moderators may remove content after a notice.
cuidado.niveisTexto: Everyone starts at level 0. A person moves up on their own through account age, participation (support and saves given) and posts without moderation decisions against them. An upheld decision lowers the level. Level 4 is appointed by the coordination.
cuidado.niveisSemLeitura: We count what you do, never what you read: Alumia does not track your reading.
cuidado.semProcedente: days without a decision against you
cuidado.faltamSemProcedente: go {n} days without a moderation decision against you

erros.modo_lento: This place is in slow mode: wait a little before writing again.
erros.nivel_links: Your level does not allow that many links in a post yet. See the limits in How Alumia cares.
erros.nivel_imagens: Your level does not allow that many images in a post yet. See the limits in How Alumia cares.
erros.limite_diario: You reached today's post limit for your level.
erros.lista_bloqueio: This place's mediators do not allow posts from you here.
erros.outra_pessoa: Another moderator has to decide: you made the decision under appeal.
erros.prazo_vencido: The 30-day deadline to appeal has passed.
erros.recurso_ja_feito: This decision already has an appeal.
erros.muitos_silenciados: You reached the limit of muted items (200).
erros.lista_cheia: The list reached its limit of 300 items.
erros.responda_perguntas: This community asks questions before the request: answer them to ask.

motivos.automod_dominio: community filter: link to an address on the list

regras.precaucao_menor: precautionary hold: report that the account belongs to someone under 18
regras.menor_de_18: Alumia is only for people 18 or older
regras.precaucao: precautionary hold until the report is read

ferramentas.nenhuma: You don't moderate any community yet.

filtro.lead: The filter only holds the post for the moderators to read. Nothing is deleted, the author sees that the post is waiting, and the rule is shown to anyone who posts here.
filtro.linksZero: Every post with a link waits to be read
filtro.linksAcima: More than {n} waits to be read
filtro.dominios: Addresses that wait to be read
filtro.dominiosAjuda: One per line, like short.example. Subdomains count too.
filtro.dominioRuim: This doesn't look like an address: {d}
filtro.combinado: With new account and the queue together, only a new account's first posts wait. New account alone: all of its posts wait. Queue alone: the first posts of anyone who arrives.
filtro.palavrasAjuda: A post with one of these words waits to be read. The list belongs to the moderators: people who post know it exists, not what is on it.
filtro.explicacao: The rule in words (people who post here read this)
filtro.explicacaoDica: E.g.: A post with more than one link waits for the moderators to read it. Nothing is deleted.
filtro.salvo: Filter saved. The rule applies now.

lento.ajuda: One post every so often, per person. Moderators don't wait. Before writing, people see how long is left.

brigada.ajuda: When many accounts from outside the community reply to the same post in a short time, only the moderators get an alert. Alumia doesn't say who replied: only how many accounts.
brigada.contas: From how many outside accounts (at least 3)
brigada.lentoConversa: 10 min slow mode on the thread
brigada.motivoTravar: Many replies from accounts outside the community in a short time: the moderators locked the thread so it can get back on track.
brigada.feito: Done. It was recorded in the moderation log.

perguntas.ajuda: Up to 3 questions for people who ask to join. Only the moderators read the answers, and they disappear once the request is decided.
perguntas.soRestrita: Only a community with join requests (restricted) asks questions.

pedidos.semResposta: Asked before the community had questions.
pedidos.aceito: Request accepted. The person was notified.
pedidos.recusado: Request declined. The person was notified.

responder.titulo: Before you ask, the moderators have questions
responder.ajuda: Only this community's moderators read the answers, and they disappear once the request is decided.

regras.links0: A post with a link waits for the moderators to read it.
regras.linksN: A post with more than {n} links waits for the moderators to read it.
regras.dominios: Links to these addresses wait to be read: {lista}.
regras.contaNova: Account younger than {n} days: the post waits to be read.
regras.contaNovaFila: Account younger than {dias} days: the first {n} posts wait to be read.
regras.novatos: The first {n} posts of newcomers wait to be read.
regras.palavras: The moderators keep a list of words: a post with one of them waits to be read.
regras.nada: No automatic filter is on here.
regras.nadaApaga: The filter deletes nothing: the moderators read and release.
regras.novata: You are in the newcomer queue: your next post will wait for the moderators to read it.
regras.falta: You can post here again in {tempo}.

antes.lento: Slow mode in this community: you can post here again in {tempo}.
antes.filtro: This post will wait for the moderators to read it ({motivo}). Nothing is deleted.

soneca.explica: Snooze: it disappears from your feed for a while and comes back by itself. Nobody is told.
soneca.feitoSempre: Muted until you undo it. Nobody is notified.
soneca.aparelhoSemPrazo: This device only has no time limit: it stays until you undo it.
soneca.dicaComunidade: Write the community address to turn on the snooze.
